selection_rule: Among TP, maximise fake_score; tie-break smallest sample_id.
Among TN, minimise fake_score; tie-break smallest sample_id.
Among FP, maximise fake_score (most extreme false alarm); tie-break smallest sample_id.
Among FN, minimise fake_score (most extreme miss); tie-break smallest sample_id.
Among correct predictions, minimise |fake_score − active_threshold|; tie-break smallest sample_id.
Among incorrect predictions, minimise |fake_score − active_threshold|; tie-break smallest sample_id.
Optional: available specialists unanimously agree with active prediction; prefer largest |fake_score − threshold|; tie-break smallest sample_id.
Optional: available specialists disagree with active prediction (or mixed); prefer largest |fake_score − threshold|; tie-break smallest sample_id.
